53: 		if !ok {

55: 		}
56: 
57: 		// Determine what we're looking for
58: 		addr := arn.ResourceAddr()
59: 
60: 		// Get the configuration.
61: 		config := t.Config.Descendent(addr.Module)
62: 
63: 		if config == nil {
64: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: %q (%T) has no configuration available", dag.VertexName(v), v)
65: 		} else if r := config.Module.ResourceByAddr(addr.Resource); r != nil {
66: 			log.Printf("[TRACE] AttachResourceConfigTransformer: attaching to %q (%T) config from %#v", dag.VertexName(v), v, r.DeclRange)

72: 				} else {
